mapper.select: SELECT id, name, note, source_workspace_id, source_workspace_name, item_count, created_at FROM workspace_archive ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_archive (name, note, source_workspace_id, source_workspace_name, item_count, payload) VALUES (#{name}, #{note}, #{sourceWorkspaceId}, #{sourceWorkspaceName}, #{itemCount}, #{payload})
